title: Node.js stack frame disclosed in a response
description: The response body carries a Node.js stack frame. Node.js stack frames expose file paths, line numbers, and internal module names to any client that can trigger the error.
remediation: Disable stack output in production and return a generic error page (a generic error page with a correlation ID).
limitation: Pattern on one body: a Node.js trace quoted in a help article can match. Development output and production exposure look the same.

observation.body: Error handled; see the server log for details.
